user.title: Set up household
user.description: A few questions about your household. Afterwards the setup only asks what fits.

data.name: Name
data.rhythm: How often do you pay advances?

klima.title: Heating and temperature
klima.description: For the heating forecast: daily mean outdoor temperature and degree days.

data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: For degree days and the learned coefficient. Without an outdoor temperature there is no heating forecast.
data_description.heating_limit: Days with a mean below this count as heating days (usually 15 °C).

abschluss.title: Almost done
abschluss.description:
Afterwards add your meters via “Add meter” on the “Tarif-Cockpit” entry. Matching your answers: {zaehler}.

Optional via “Add heat generator”: {erzeuger}.

data_description.tolerance_pct: Deviation up to which the verdict is “on track”.

abort.single_instance_allowed: A household already exists. Add more meters there via “Add meter”.

user.title: Add meter
user.description: What does the meter measure? Still missing for your household: {fehlen}.

quelle.title: Where does the meter reading come from?
quelle.description: Choose the meter reading sensor (running total). Without a sensor you enter readings by hand (action “Add meter reading”).

data.name: Name
data.pulse_entity: Pulse counter (instead of a meter sensor)

data_description.history_entity: Optional. Fills days the meter sensor has no statistics for yet, e.g. with the inverter's grid import meter. Such days count as estimated.
data_description.role: A wallbox or garden meter is a sub-meter of a main meter without its own contract.
data_description.pulse_entity: E.g. an ESPHome pulse counter or counter helper counting the meter's pulses. The pulse constant follows in the next step.

unterzaehler.title: Main meter
unterzaehler.description: Which main meter does this sub-meter belong to?

einheit.title: Unit
einheit.description: Which unit does the meter count in? A gas meter counting in m³ needs the calorific value and conversion factor from your gas bill.

data.annual_consumption: Annual consumption according to the last bill

data_description.annual_consumption: Optional. Fallback for the forecast as long as there is no previous year and no 30 days of own data.
data_description.pulse_constant: On the meter, e.g. “1 imp = 0.01 m³” (then 0.01 and “unit per pulse”) or “100 imp/m³”.

preis.title: Prices
preis.description: Prices at the start of the contract, as in the contract (gross or net as chosen before). Later price changes via “Reconfigure” on the meter (or the action “Set price”).

data.demand_price: Demand charge per kW and year

data_description.price_unit: District heating is often billed per MWh; internally it is calculated per kWh.

abschlag.title: Advance payments
abschlag.description: Without an amount there are no advance payments. Later changes via “Reconfigure” on the meter, in the card or with the action “Set advance payment”.

vertrag.title: Contract
vertrag.description: When does your supplier bill? For “fixed day” enter the first day of the new billing period as DD.MM, e.g. 30.06. (each period then ends on 29.06.). For “manual” enter the end of the first period; add further periods with the action “Append period”.

data_description.min_term_months: Leave empty if unknown. Without it there is no notice-period reminder.
data_description.notice_period_weeks: How many weeks before the contract end must you cancel? (6 weeks ≈ 1.5 months)

startstand.title: Initial reading
startstand.description: First billing periods: {preview} (¹ = short year). Enter the meter reading at the start of the contract; optional for a meter with a sensor.

stammdaten.title: Change meter
stammdaten.description: Change contracts, prices and advance payments with the Tarif-Cockpit actions.

data.name: Name
data.annual_consumption: Annual consumption according to the last bill

data_description.pulse_constant: On the meter, e.g. “1 imp = 0.01 m³” (then 0.01 and “unit per pulse”) or “100 imp/m³”.

reconfigure.title: Change meter
reconfigure.description: What do you want to change?

zusammenfassung.title: Summary

preis_aendern.title: Change price
preis_aendern.description: New price from a date; the previous one ends the day before. Ended periods stay unchanged. {error}

data.demand_price: Demand charge per kW and year

abschlag_aendern.title: Change advance payment
abschlag_aendern.description: New advance from a payment day; earlier dates stay unchanged. {error}

anbieterwechsel.title: Change supplier
anbieterwechsel.description: The current contract ends the day before the switch (final bill). The switch reading is optional; if the switch is in the future, add it afterwards with the action “Add reading”. {error}

data.switch_date: First day with the new supplier

wechsel_vertrag.title: New contract
wechsel_vertrag.description: New contract from {datum}. When does the new supplier bill? Fixed day as DD.MM (first day of the period).

data_description.min_term_months: Leave empty if unknown. Without it there is no notice-period reminder.
data_description.notice_period_weeks: How many weeks before the contract end must you cancel? (6 weeks ≈ 1.5 months)

wechsel_preis.title: Prices and advance of the new contract

data.demand_price: Demand charge per kW and year

vertrag_aendern.title: Change contract
vertrag_aendern.description: Current contract with {lieferant} since {beginn}. Periods, prices and advances stay unchanged.

data_description.min_term_months: Leave empty if unknown. Without it there is no notice-period reminder.
data_description.notice_period_weeks: How many weeks before the contract end must you cancel? (6 weeks ≈ 1.5 months)

error.already_configured: This sensor is already assigned to a meter.
error.invalid_billing: The billing rule is invalid (e.g. fixed day is not a valid DD.MM; 29.02. is not allowed).
error.required_for_manual: “Manual” needs the end of the first period.
error.required_without_entity: Without a meter sensor an initial reading is required.
error.no_main_meter: There is no main meter of this utility yet.
error.required_for_m3: A gas meter in m³ needs the calorific value and conversion factor (on your gas bill).
error.billing_error: Not possible, see the note above.
error.switch_invalid: A switch on this date is not possible, see the note above.
error.switch_reading_future: The switch is in the future: please enter the meter reading after the switch (action “Add reading”).
error.entity_or_pulses: Please choose either a meter sensor or a pulse counter, not both.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded right now. Please check and reload it under Settings → Devices & services.
abort.no_contract: This meter has no contract yet.

user.title: Add heat generator
user.description: Optional: boiler, heat pump, split air conditioner or wood stove. Matching your household: {vorschlag}.

data_description.name: Optional, otherwise the name of the type.

zuordnung.title: Energy
zuordnung.description: Where does the generator get its energy from? A split air conditioner usually runs on household electricity.

leistung.title: Power
leistung.description: Power range for heating according to the rating plate or data sheet.

data_description.nominal_kw: On the rating plate or data sheet. Use the values for heating, e.g. 16 for “5–16 kW”.
data_description.efficiency: Assumption until measurements exist. Gas boiler based on net calorific value (≈ 0.9), wood stove ≈ 0.75.
data_description.cop: Assumption until a heat meter exists.
data_description.max_dhw_kw: Optional: hot water peaks are then not flagged.

entitaeten.title: Measurements (optional)
entitaeten.description: The more is measured, the fewer assumptions. Everything is optional.

data.energy: Energy input (kWh, e.g. smart plug or heat pump meter)

data_description.state: E.g. a binary sensor “running”. Operating hours come from it.
data_description.room: For a wood stove without operating state: detection by the temperature rise.

ofen.title: Wood stove
ofen.description: The relief of the heating is learned once there are 10 days with and without the stove at similar weather; until then an assumption from the rated power applies.

data_description.stove_threshold_k: Only in the heating season. Usually 1.5 K.
data_description.effective_share: Which part of the stove heat really relieves the heating (assumption, e.g. 0.6) until there are enough comparison days.
data_description.wood_price: Optional, for the estimated wood costs.
data_description.kg_per_rm: Assumption: beech/hardwood about 400 kg per stacked cubic metre.

data.name: Name
data.energy: Energy input (kWh, e.g. smart plug or heat pump meter)

data_description.nominal_kw: On the rating plate or data sheet. Use the values for heating, e.g. 16 for “5–16 kW”.
data_description.efficiency: Assumption until measurements exist. Gas boiler based on net calorific value (≈ 0.9), wood stove ≈ 0.75.

data_description.wood_price: Optional, for the estimated wood costs.

error.min_above_nominal: The minimum power is above the rated power.
error.state_entity_missing: The “operating state” entity is missing in the previous step.
error.room_entity_missing: The “room temperature where installed” entity is missing.
error.stove_entity_required: The wood stove needs the operating state or the room temperature where installed, otherwise no stove hours can be detected.

options.air_air_hp: Split air conditioner / air-to-air heat pump

options.input: Rated heat input (gas, net calorific value)

add_ablesung.name: Add meter reading
add_ablesung.description: Adds a meter reading. With “Replaces” an earlier reading is corrected without deleting it.

stand.name: Reading
stand.description: Meter reading in the meter unit.

ersetzt.name: Replaces
ersetzt.description: ID of the reading being corrected (attribute ablesung_id).

ablesung_ungueltig.name: Mark reading invalid
ablesung_ungueltig.description: Marks a reading as invalid. It is kept but no longer used in calculations.

add_folgevertrag.name: Follow-up contract (supplier change)
add_folgevertrag.description: The current contract ends the day before the start (final bill); the new contract begins.

abrechnungsregel.name: Billing
abrechnungsregel.description: When does the new supplier bill?

stichtag.name: Fixed day
stichtag.description: For “fixed day”: first day of the period as DD.MM.

wechselstand.name: Switch reading
wechselstand.description: Meter reading at the switch. If missing, add it later as a reading.

kuendigungsfrist.name: Notice period
kuendigungsfrist.description: In weeks before the contract end.

set_periodenende.name: Billing period end (reading date)
set_periodenende.description: The supplier read the meter a few days earlier or later: shift the end of the current or the last ended period (at most ±10 days). The rule stays.

ende.name: End
ende.description: Last day of the period according to the bill.

add_periode.name: Append period (manual)
add_periode.description: Only for “manual” billing: append the next period. It starts the day after the last one ends.

ende.name: End
ende.description: Last day of the new period.

set_preis.name: Set price
set_preis.description: New price segment from a date (price change, or correction with the same date). The previous segment ends the day before. The consumption forecast stays unchanged.

ab.name: Valid from
ab.description: First day of the new price.

leistungspreis.name: Demand charge
leistungspreis.description: District heating, per kW and year.

set_abschlag.name: Set advance payment
set_abschlag.description: New advance payment step from a date; optionally change day, interval and count.

ab.name: Valid from
ab.description: First payment day with the new amount.

add_zahlung.name: Add payment
add_zahlung.description: Actual payment, one-off payment, credit or refund. A recorded advance replaces the planned one in the same month.

betrag.name: Amount
betrag.description: Always positive; credits and refunds reduce payments.

add_rechnung.name: Add invoice
add_rechnung.description: Supplier invoice (separate from payments). With “corrects” as a correction invoice.

recalculate.name: Recalculate daily values
recalculate.description: Recalculates daily values from statistics and readings. Readings and contracts stay unchanged.

uebernahme_v03.name: Take over from version 0.3
uebernahme_v03.description: Reads the helpers of the template version 0.3 (advance, prices, starting reading …) and takes them over into a meter. Response: values taken over and skipped.

ab.name: Valid from
ab.description: Default: billing start or start of the current period.

grundpreis.name: Standing charge per month
grundpreis.description: Helper from 0.3: Standing charge per month.

startstand.name: Meter reading at billing start
startstand.description: Helper from 0.3: Meter reading at billing start.

store_verloren.title: Tarif-Cockpit: stored data missing
store_verloren.description: The file `.storage/{key}` is missing or was corrupt (Home Assistant then renames it to `{key}.corrupt.…`). To avoid data loss, Tarif-Cockpit does not start with empty data. Please restore the file from a backup and restart Home Assistant.

store_ungueltig.title: Tarif-Cockpit: stored data invalid
store_ungueltig.description: {count} errors were found in `.storage/{key}`, e.g.: {errors}. The file was not changed. Please download the diagnostics and open an issue, or restore a backup.

alte_dashboard_installation.title: Tarif-Cockpit: old dashboard installation
alte_dashboard_installation.description: The cards are now loaded by the integration. The earlier dashboard installation loads them a second time (`/hacsfiles/tarif-cockpit/`). Please remove the dashboard installation in the Marketplace, see MIGRATION.md.

store_zu_neu.title: Tarif-Cockpit: data from a newer version
store_zu_neu.description: `.storage/{key}` was written by a newer version of Tarif-Cockpit. The file stays unchanged. Please install the newer version again.

zaehler_ohne_statistik.title: Tarif-Cockpit: no statistics for {meter}
zaehler_ohne_statistik.description: There are no long-term statistics with a running sum for `{entity}`. The sensor needs `state_class: total_increasing` (or `total`). Until then the daily values of this meter are missing; they are not counted as 0.

abgleich_abweichung.title: {meter}: sensor differs from the reading
abgleich_abweichung.description: Between the readings from {von} to {bis} the sensor counted {pct} % relative to the read quantity (missing: {fehlt} {unit}). Adjusted: {angeglichen}. Causes: lost pulses, wrong pulse constant, meter replacement or a wrongly entered reading. The notice disappears once the next reading is below 2 % again.

kuendigungsfrist.title: {meter}: notice period ends soon
kuendigungsfrist.description: The contract with {lieferant} ends on {ende}. To switch, cancel by {bis} ({tage} days left). The notice disappears after the deadline or when you adjust term or notice period under “Change contract”.

reading_in_future.message: The reading time is in the future.

reading_already_replaced.message: This reading is already replaced or invalid ({id}). Please refer to the currently valid reading.

init.title: Change household
init.description: Changes reload Tarif-Cockpit. Meters, contracts and data are kept.
